newsitem.title: UK: Esprit Telecom to float via debut public offering.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Telecom to float via debut public offering.

text.p: Esprit Telecom Group, a European telecommunications company, has registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) for an initial public offering of 5.4 million American Depositary Shares (ADSs) of the company, it said in a statement on Sunday.
Esprit Telecom has applied for quotation of its ADSs on NASDAQ and EASDAQ.

The offering by Espirit Telecom will include a U.S. and an international offering. The offering is expected to comprise approximately 37 million ordinary shares all in the form of ADSs at an estimated initial public price range of $13 to $15 per ADS which values the initital public offering at between $70 and $81 million for just under 15 percent of the company.
The likely market capitalisation will be between $480 and $555 million.
Each ADS represents the right to receive seven ordinary shares.
Investors in Esprit Telecom include Apax Partners, Hancock Venture Partners and E.M. Warburg Pincus & Co.
Lehman Brothers is lead manager of the offerings.
